Microsoft AI Applications Integration Workbench

Governed AI for decisions between enterprise systems.

A working higher-education prototype demonstrating how governed AI can connect enterprise systems, assist human decisions, and create auditable workflows.

See how it works technically Try the working demo
Illustrative use case

SIS Data Reconciliation

When two enterprise systems need to exchange or transition data, for example during an SIS modernization, records often do not match perfectly. This prototype demonstrates how deterministic rules, AI-assisted exception review, human approval, and Microsoft enterprise controls can make that process safer and more efficient.

System-of-record authority is always preserved.
What problem?Manual, inconsistent reconciliation across enterprise systems.
What does AI do?Helps analyze only the difficult exceptions.
What does the human do?Makes accountable decisions.
What does Microsoft provide?Identity, security, integration, workflow, monitoring and analytics.
Why does this matter?Cleaner data, lower operational effort, stronger governance and a reusable AI integration pattern.

A practical path from prototype to governed implementation.

Implementation sequence

What an institutional implementation would require

Not connected to a tenant
1. Establish identity

Configure Entra ID, application roles, Conditional Access and named owners.

2. Approve integrations

Use supported SIS, LMS and Microsoft APIs with least-privilege credentials.

3. Validate controls

Evaluate rules, model behavior, privacy, retention and human approval gates.

4. Measure operations

Publish throughput, exception aging, adoption and audit-coverage measures.
